email.subject: Quick note on Evergreen's website
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I took a look at Evergreen Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching for emergency heating or AC repair can't reach you with one tap, and there's no way to book a service online, so anyone browsing after hours just leaves. The page is also slow to load because of heavy, unoptimized images, which pushes people away before they see your services.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
